peers.name: HOME FIRST FIN CO IND LTD

bull_bear.body:
- Balance sheet as at Jun'26: total assets Rs 1,32,630.9 Mn, loans Rs 1,05,831.6 Mn, borrowings other than debt securities Rs 90,309.2 Mn, debt securities Rs 10,201.8 Mn and total equity Rs 29,393.3 Mn (equity share capital Rs 1,677.7 Mn plus other equity Rs 27,715.6 Mn).
- Funding is diversified by lender type at Q1 FY'27: Private Sector Banks 49%, Public Sector Banks 17%, Foreign Banks 10%, Retail 7%, NBFC 6%, Foreign DFI 5%, Domestic DFI 4%, SFB 3%.
- Structured funding is a deliberate lever: PTC borrowing was 39% (Rs 10,789 Mn) versus other borrowing 61% (Rs 16,545 Mn) in Q1 FY'27 against 34% (Rs 32,897 Mn) versus 66% (Rs 62,477 Mn) in FY26, and "MML Expect to borrow 30% of the incremental borrowing through PTC route."
- Credit ratings: CRISIL AA-/Stable for long-term, ECB and NCD, CRISIL A1+ for CP, MFI grading M1C1, and CARE Edge BB-/Stable for the Global (GIFT City) rating; the deck records an "MML Rating upgrade to 'AA-/Stable'" in 2026 following a 2025 CRISIL outlook revision to Positive on Crisil A+.
- Provisioning stance is conservative and disclosed as such: "the overall provision coverage on total assets stands at 3.7%... The IRAAC provision is much lower than the ECL with a gap of 210 Cr, the overall provision is at Rs. 408 Cr. There is no management overlay in the provision."
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "One of the few NBFC-MFIs where the original promoters have continued to retain ownership and control over the business"; Muthoot Microfin is described as "the 2nd Largest company by AUM under the Muthoot Pappachan Group", a group with a "Legacy of 138+ years of history".
- Deck footnote positions the company "Among the top 10 NBFC-MFIs in India (Source: CRISIL Report)"; MPG is present across microfinance, gold finance, two-wheeler finance and housing finance.
- Shareholding as of June'26: MFL 50.21%, Non-institutions 16.44%, GPC 15.13%, Creation 7.63%, Individual Promoters 5.26%, Domestic institutions 3.38%, ESOP 1.60%, Foreign institutions 0.35%. Promoters have cumulatively infused Rs 3,421 Mn into MML.
- Distribution reach of 1,671 branches across 392 districts, with rural AUM penetration "stable at 97.3% in Q1 FY'27, reflecting the MML's continued focus on rural lending."
- Regional concentration: South is "the anchor market", contributing 63% of the individual loan portfolio and 49% of overall AUM; district concentration is low with Top 1 at 3%, Top 3 at 8%, Top 5 at 11%, Top 10 at 19% and Other 81% of GLP.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Revised FY27 guidance] The full guidance table was revised: AUM growth 12%-15% to 18%-20%, NIM held at 12.3%-12.5%, operating cost 6.2%-6.4% to 6.1%-6.4%, credit cost 2.7%-3.0% to 2.5%-3.0%, RoA 2.5%-3.0% to 2.5%-3.3%, and RoE 12%-15% to 12%-18%.
- [ECL macro sensitivity] "MML ECL policy includes GDP and Inflation as macro factors along with Per Capita Income and Unemployment. The RBI positive revision on GDP forecast and Inflation can have a positive bearing on the Credit cost."
- [Stress history] The AUM/GNPA history slide annotates prior stress events - "TN Floods & PB Karza Mukti 2024", "TN, BH, WB & OD Floods & Fengal cyclone 2024", "Heat wave, Flood & Election 2024" and "Rain Impact in Northern & Western States" - as the context for the FY25-FY26 GNPA peak of 4.85%.
- [Regulatory/licence] Secured an e-KYC licence to conduct Aadhaar-enabled e-KYC for customer onboarding (2025), and won the TransUnion CIBIL Best Data Quality Award in the Microfinance Institutions segment.
- [Risk infrastructure] A "Unique credit score developed along with Equifax", dedicated credit managers at all branches, an internal audit team that "Audits each branch at least once every quarter", and independent branch credit managers separate from relationship managers.

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Muthoot Microfin as a promoter-controlled, rural-focused NBFC-MFI within the 138+ year Muthoot Pappachan Group, pivoting from pure JLG microfinance to a diversified, increasingly secured and digitally collected book led by the Muthoot Small Enterprise Loan (MSEL) product, on a stated platform of "quality-led growth".

open.item: Recovered ~INR62 cr from overdues in Q3 (vs INR57 cr Q2); expects ~INR75 cr in Q4, with 90-plus recovery back to ~30% and targeting ~40%.
Cost-to-income already at ~54.8%, better than the ~55% full-year guidance; on path to reach optimal ~43% in another 9-12 months.
Applied for CGFMU guarantee (tactical, for higher-risk states); expects approval within the next couple of quarters.
Targets crossing 3% ROA in FY27 (long-run 3.5% over 3-5 years) and 14%-18% ROE at ~4-4.5x leverage; next year expected to be a clean year.
Broad FY27 guidance of ~20% AUM growth, targeting ~INR17,000 cr from ~INR14,000 cr; 20% growth also for the subsequent year.
Vision 3030: reach INR30,000 cr AUM by 2030 (from ~INR14,000 cr today), via ~INR11,000 cr from wallet-share growth, ~INR4,300 cr from new customers.
Vision 3030: consistently deliver ROA of 5% and above by 2030.
Target to raise NCD/ECB share of borrowings from ~22% to ~40% by 2030.
Vision 3030: 75% of collections entirely digital by 2030 (from ~40% incremental today).
Vision 3030: average ticket size to ~INR1.5 lakh and per-staff productivity to ~INR18-19 lakh/month by 2030.
Vision 3030: by 2030, 53% JLG and 47% non-JLG (individual/MSEL ~33%, LAP ~10%, retail secured incl. gold/2W/UCV ~3%).
Vision 3030: touch 10 million lives by 2030, acquiring ~1.3 lakh new customers/year (~5.5 lakh over four years).
Vision 3030: deliver ROE of 20% and above by 2030.
Plan to grow wallet share with existing customers by ~2% per annum over four years, since their microfinance wallet share fell from 54% to 38% while gold/business/LAP borrowing rose sharply.
Targets a structurally lower long-term (5-year) credit cost of 2%-2.5% and ROA of 3%-3.5% via diversification into event-risk-insulated products (individual/LAP/gold).
Long-term goal to reach and transform 10 million households as its stated vision.
~20,000-22,000 NATCAT insurance claims (Odisha cyclone, Bihar floods) pending; settlement expected to improve collections, with ~INR8-9 cr provision impact if unresolved.
Policy of not declaring dividend while in growth phase, reinvesting capital and profits for growth.

verdicts.item: Micro LAP portfolio reached ~INR22 cr (zero delinquency); confident of reaching the guided ~INR50 cr AUM.
verdicts.note: MSME/Micro LAP 'AUM stands at around 47... 100% collection... don't have any delinquency' — approaching the guided ~INR50 cr AUM. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: Guided FY26 ROA of ~2% and ROE of ~10%, recovering to ~4% ROA (18%-20% ROE) in FY27, barring adverse events.
verdicts.note: Q4 hit '2.1% ROA standalone... 10% ROE', but full-year PAT INR170 cr implies full-year ROA below ~2%. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: Reaffirmed FY26 credit cost guidance of 4%-6%, tracking at the lower end (~4.3% in Q1) and likely to come in below guidance.
verdicts.note: FY26 full-year credit cost 3.5% (Q4 2.8%) — below the 4%-6% lower end as management expected.

verdicts.item: Sharply raised FY25 credit cost guidance to 7.5%-8.5% (from 3.3%-3.75%), budgeting for worst-case Karnataka legislation and Fengal cyclone; hopes to do better.
verdicts.note: FY25 credit cost 'almost 9.4% full year' — above even the raised 7.5%-8.5% guidance. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: Plan to build a ~INR5,000 cr secured loan portfolio (gold/LAP/two-wheeler/housing) by cross-selling to the ~12.7 lakh existing customers who already hold ~INR28,000 cr of retail loans, without over-leveraging.
verdicts.note: Individual loan ~INR2,387 cr and LAP building; non-JLG 17% of INR14,005 cr — progressing toward the ~INR5,000 cr secured target. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: Opex to be retained in the same range as FY25 in FY26.
verdicts.note: Opex 'peaked to almost 7%... come back to almost 6.4%' in FY26 — broadly similar range but ran higher during the year.

verdicts.item: Corporate agency license from IRDA expected to add fee income; ~5-10% commission on ~INR600-650 cr of insurance premium processed, ~5% flowing to top line.
